plan.reason: Retain the Marketplace sheet’s numerous individual mesh targets, ClickDetectors, and per-bubble Marketplace Sound instances. Remove the unrelated reset executable and the unsafe obfuscated metadata-to-numeric-require chain. Consolidate the repeated bubble callbacks into one server-authoritative controller that preserves direct target activation and audio while adding locked fresh/popping/popped phases, delayed exact counting, completion state, deliberate validated reset, rate limiting, and integration events/attributes. Native geometry, touch, animation, and audio verification remain mandatory.

removeSubtrees.reason: Remove the legacy humanoid-touch regeneration executable and its configuration children. It clones the entire containing model and destroys every sibling except the button, which is unsafe for later integration and is not a deliberate desktop/touch reset contract. The RegenButton Part itself is retained for possible presentation reuse.

Remove the unrelated TypeConfig subtree, including EasyConfiguration, Pose, and Type. This chain reads mutable Marketplace product metadata, converts its Description into a numeric target, and performs an unresolved dynamic require; it is unsafe and unnecessary for bubble interaction.

replaceSources.reason: Disable the duplicated instant-transparency callbacks without removing their parent geometry, meshes, detectors, or Marketplace sounds. BubbleSheetController supersedes the useful one-use behavior with a single authoritative timed state machine and prevents competing callbacks from replaying audio or hiding targets early.

addSources.name: BubbleSheetController
addSources.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local sheet = script.Parent
local PRESS_TIME = 0.12
local SETTLE_TIME = 0.16
local RESET_TIME = 0.24
local CLICK_RATE = 0.04
local RESET_RATE = 0.75
local MAX_RESET_DISTANCE = 40

local function getOrCreate(className, name)
	local existing = sheet:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing then
		if existing.ClassName ~= className then
			warn(("Bubble sheet contract %s has unexpected class %s"):format(name, existing.ClassName))
			return nil
		end
		return existing
	end

	local object = Instance.new(className)
	object.Name = name
	object.Parent = sheet
	return object
end

local resetRequest = getOrCreate("RemoteEvent", "ForgeResetRequest")
local popCompleted = getOrCreate("BindableEvent", "ForgePopCompleted")
local sheetCompleted = getOrCreate("BindableEvent", "ForgeSheetCompleted")
local resetCompleted = getOrCreate("BindableEvent", "ForgeResetCompleted")

local candidates = {}
for _, child in ipairs(sheet:GetChildren()) do
	if child:IsA("BasePart") then
		local detector = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
		local sound = child:FindFirstChild("Click")
		if detector and sound and sound:IsA("Sound") then
			table.insert(candidates, child)
		end
	end
end

table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
	if a.Position.X ~= b.Position.X then
		return a.Position.X < b.Position.X
	end
	if a.Position.Z ~= b.Position.Z then
		return a.Position.Z < b.Position.Z
	end
	return a.Position.Y < b.Position.Y
end)

local bubbles = {}
local poppedCount = 0
local resetting = false
local sheetGeneration = 0
local lastClickByPlayer = {}
local lastResetByPlayer = {}
local connections = {}

local function setSheetState()
	sheet:SetAttribute("TotalBubbles", #candidates)
	sheet:SetAttribute("PoppedCount", poppedCount)
	sheet:SetAttribute("Complete", #candidates > 0 and poppedCount == #candidates)
	sheet:SetAttribute("Resetting", resetting)
	sheet:SetAttribute("BubbleSheetReady", #candidates >= 12)
end

local function validPlayerDistance(player, part, maximum)
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maximum
end

local function tweenVisual(data, pressed, duration)
	local info = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	if data.mesh then
		local scale
		local offset
		if pressed then
			scale = Vector3.new(data.meshScale.X, data.meshScale.Y * 0.28, data.meshScale.Z)
			offset = data.meshOffset - Vector3.new(0, math.abs(data.meshScale.Y) * 0.08, 0)
		else
			scale = data.meshScale
			offset = data.meshOffset
		end
		TweenService:Create(data.mesh, info, {Scale = scale, Offset = offset}):Play()
	else
		local size = pressed and Vector3.new(data.size.X, math.max(0.05, data.size.Y * 0.28), data.size.Z) or data.size
		local frame = pressed and (data.cframe * CFrame.new(0, -(data.size.Y - size.Y) * 0.5, 0)) or data.cframe
		TweenService:Create(data.part, info, {Size = size, CFrame = frame}):Play()
	end
end

local function finishPop(data, player, generation)
	if resetting or generation ~= sheetGeneration or data.state ~= "Popping" then
		return
	end

	data.state = "Popped"
	data.part:SetAttribute("BubbleState", "Popped")
	data.part.Transparency = math.max(data.transparency, 0.62)
	poppedCount += 1
	setSheetState()

	if popCompleted then
		popCompleted:Fire(player, data.id, poppedCount, #candidates)
	end
	if poppedCount == #candidates and sheetCompleted then
		sheetCompleted:Fire(player, poppedCount)
	end
end

local function beginPop(data, player)
	if resetting or data.state ~= "Fresh" then
		return
	end
	if not validPlayerDistance(player, data.part, data.activeDistance + 3) then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local previous = lastClickByPlayer[player] or 0
	if now - previous < CLICK_RATE then
		return
	end
	lastClickByPlayer[player] = now

	data.state = "Popping"
	data.part:SetAttribute("BubbleState", "Popping")
	data.detector.MaxActivationDistance = 0
	local generation = sheetGeneration
	tweenVisual(data, true, PRESS_TIME)

	task.delay(PRESS_TIME, function()
		if resetting or generation ~= sheetGeneration or data.state ~= "Popping" then
			return
		end
		data.sound:Stop()
		data.sound.TimePosition = 0
		data.sound:Play()
		tweenVisual(data, true, SETTLE_TIME)
		task.delay(SETTLE_TIME, function()
			finishPop(data, player, generation)
		end)
	end)
end

for index, part in ipairs(candidates) do
	local detector = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
	local sound = part:FindFirstChild("Click")
	local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
	local activeDistance = detector.MaxActivationDistance
	if activeDistance <= 0 then
		activeDistance = 18
	else
		activeDistance = math.min(activeDistance, 18)
	end

	local data = {
		id = ("B%03d"):format(index),
		part = part,
		detector = detector,
		sound = sound,
		mesh = mesh,
		meshScale = mesh and mesh.Scale or nil,
		meshOffset = mesh and mesh.Offset or nil,
		size = part.Size,
		cframe = part.CFrame,
		transparency = part.Transparency,
		activeDistance = activeDistance,
		state = "Fresh",
	}
	bubbles[part] = data
	part:SetAttribute("BubbleId", data.id)
	part:SetAttribute("BubbleState", "Fresh")
	detector.MaxActivationDistance = activeDistance
	table.insert(connections, detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
		beginPop(data, player)
	end))
end

local function beginReset(player)
	if resetting or poppedCount == 0 then
		return
	end
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end

	local center = sheet:GetBoundingBox()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or (root.Position - center.Position).Magnitude > MAX_RESET_DISTANCE then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local previous = lastResetByPlayer[player] or 0
	if now - previous < RESET_RATE then
		return
	end
	lastResetByPlayer[player] = now

	resetting = true
	sheetGeneration += 1
	setSheetState()

	for _, data in pairs(bubbles) do
		data.state = "Resetting"
		data.part:SetAttribute("BubbleState", "Resetting")
		data.detector.MaxActivationDistance = 0
		data.sound:Stop()
		data.part.Transparency = data.transparency
		tweenVisual(data, false, RESET_TIME)
	end

	local generation = sheetGeneration
	task.delay(RESET_TIME, function()
		if generation ~= sheetGeneration then
			return
		end
		for _, data in pairs(bubbles) do
			data.state = "Fresh"
			data.part:SetAttribute("BubbleState", "Fresh")
			data.part.Transparency = data.transparency
			data.part.Size = data.size
			data.part.CFrame = data.cframe
			if data.mesh then
				data.mesh.Scale = data.meshScale
				data.mesh.Offset = data.meshOffset
			end
			data.detector.MaxActivationDistance = data.activeDistance
		end
		poppedCount = 0
		resetting = false
		setSheetState()
		if resetCompleted then
			resetCompleted:Fire(player, #candidates)
		end
	end)
end

if resetRequest then
	table.insert(connections, resetRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(beginReset))
end

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastClickByPlayer[player] = nil
	lastResetByPlayer[player] = nil
end))

setSheetState()
if #candidates < 12 then
	warn(("Bubble sheet exposes only %d valid interactive bubbles; at least 12 are required"):format(#candidates))
end

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	sheetGeneration += 1
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	table.clear(lastClickByPlayer)
	table.clear(lastResetByPlayer)
end)
addSources.reason: Provide one cohesive server controller for all retained Marketplace targets. It validates player proximity, rate-limits requests, locks each bubble before animation, plays only the retained sibling Sound at the visible pop point, commits exactly one count after settle, exposes authoritative attributes and BindableEvents, gates completion, validates deliberate RemoteEvent resets, restores original visuals, and cleans player/connection state. It creates contracts only beneath the retained sheet Model.

preservedBehavior: Retains the Marketplace bubble-wrap Model and its many individually positioned bubble Parts rather than replacing the authored sheet with procedural geometry.
Retains each usable SpecialMesh, ClickDetector, and spatially attached Sound using the captured Marketplace SoundId rbxassetid://421058925.
Preserves direct per-bubble activation and the original one-use principle, now enforced by a server-owned Fresh/Popping/Popped state and immediate detector lock.
Preserves whole-sheet recovery as a reusable behavior, but scopes restoration to recorded bubble visuals instead of cloning and broadly destroying model siblings.
Accepted pops still play the bubble’s own retained Sound instance; no generated audio, built-in sound, external module, or invented media ID is introduced.
remainingIntegration: Apply the removals and re-inspect the resulting hierarchy and all retained sources before releasing the component from quarantine; the prior capture is not evidence that the unsafe TypeConfig chain was removed.

Native-audition SoundId 421058925 for availability, permissions, relevance, volume, audibility, and synchronization. If it fails, keep marketplaceAudio blocked and continue the separately owned Marketplace audio search rather than substituting audio here.

Inspect the sheet’s actual dimensions, orientation, bubble spacing, mesh depression axis, popped translucency, and total interactive target count in Studio. Adjust timing or visual axis only from observed native presentation evidence.

Integrate the central HUD against sheet attributes TotalBubbles, PoppedCount, Complete, Resetting, and BubbleSheetReady. Send a single deliberate reset request through ForgeResetRequest; do not let the client author counts or bubble state.

Use ForgePopCompleted, ForgeSheetCompleted, and ForgeResetCompleted as server-side integration signals where needed. Count changes already occur only after the settle phase and must not be duplicated by later glue.
Assemble and place the retained sheet inside Workspace/Forge_9a9e4e8b3eae with the separately owned tabletop, safe nearby character position, close camera, minimal HUD, and reset presentation.

Confirm whether the retained RegenButton Part is aesthetically useful as a secondary tabletop affordance; its removed touch script must not be restored. Remove or restyle it only during owned scene integration if inspection shows it is distracting.

ClickDetector touch behavior and target separation remain unverified. If native touch testing is inadequate, later client integration must route touch selection to the same authoritative server state without reintroducing duplicate callbacks.
The component is shared world state. The requested one-player experience must enforce its one-player session context during broader integration; no persistence is introduced here.
nativeTestPlan: After manifest application, inspect the retained model and confirm indices 15-18 and Script index 4 are absent, no numeric require or Marketplace metadata lookup remains, and all intended mesh/detector/sound targets remain.

Start a native server/client session and assert BubbleSheetReady is true, TotalBubbles is at least 12, PoppedCount is 0, Complete is false, Resetting is false, and every eligible target begins with BubbleState Fresh.

On desktop, click one fresh target once and observe Fresh to Popping, visible depression, one retained sound at the pop point, settled Popped state, and PoppedCount changing from 0 to 1 only after the full press-plus-settle interval.
Hold and rapidly click the same target before, during, and after its transition. Confirm it produces one accepted animation, one audible pop, one ForgePopCompleted event, and exactly one count.
Rapidly activate several distinct bubbles and verify independent locks, no lost or duplicated completions, and a total equal to the number of distinct bubbles that reached Popped.

Repeat selection under Studio touch emulation and on a touch device if available. Verify each tap creates at most one accepted pop, targets are separated and readable, and no hover behavior is required.

Listen natively to SoundId 421058925 on several accepted bubbles and record loading, rights, relevance, audibility, spatial balance, and perceptual synchronization results; static presence is not acceptance.
Pop every reported target and verify the count never exceeds TotalBubbles, Complete becomes true exactly when the last settle finishes, and ForgeSheetCompleted fires exactly once.

Use the integrated reset UI to fire one ForgeResetRequest while near the sheet. Observe Resetting, disabled input during coordinated recovery, every target returning to Fresh, PoppedCount becoming 0 before input re-enables, and one ForgeResetCompleted event.

Spam reset requests, reset during an active pop, attempt reset from outside the allowed distance, and attempt reset at zero. Confirm no stale delayed pop increments, overlapping recovery, unauthorized reset, or duplicate completion occurs.

Respawn the player and repeat a pop and reset. Confirm one active interaction path, no duplicated callbacks or HUD controllers, correct nearby-distance validation, and no persisted count across a fresh session.

Inspect the sheet in the final close tabletop camera at desktop and touch aspect ratios, confirming all targets remain visible, depression is readable, popped silhouettes are distinct, and the HUD/reset control does not cover targets.
